- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Recommended checking specific growing conditions for each herb variety, preparing the soil by loosening it to a depth of 8-10 inches, removing debris or rocks, planting herbs at the same depth as they were in their pots, watering thoroughly, and mulching around the plants.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Mint can be invasive and is often recommended to be contained in a pot or designated area.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Basil is a more delicate herb that can be sensitive to competition from more aggressive plants like mint.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Recommended planting mint and basil in separate pots or beds.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Suggested using a large container if planting mint and basil together, providing barriers, and monitoring and maintaining the plants.
